title: Jeremiah Persecuted by Pashhur

questions.question: What was the name of the priest, chief officer in the house of the Lord, who heard Jeremiah prophesying these things?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 20:1 (ESV): "Now Pashhur the priest, the son of Immer, who was chief officer in the house of the Lord, heard Jeremiah prophesying these things."

questions.question: What did Pashhur do to Jeremiah the prophet?
options: Beat him and put him in the stocks
Cast him out of the city
questions.correctAnswer: Beat him and put him in the stocks
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 20:2 (ESV): "Then Pashhur beat Jeremiah the prophet, and put him in the stocks that were in the upper Benjamin Gate of the house of the Lord."

questions.question: The next day, when Pashhur released Jeremiah from the stocks, what did Jeremiah say the Lord called Pashhur's name?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 20:3 (ESV): "Jeremiah said to him, 'The Lord does not call your name Pashhur, but Terror on Every Side.'"

questions.question: "For thus says the Lord: Behold, I will make you a... to yourself and to all your friends. They shall fall by the sword of their enemies while you look on."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 20:4 (ESV): "Behold, I will make you a terror to yourself and to all your friends."

questions.question: "And I will give all Judah into the hand of the king of Babylon. He shall carry them captive to... , and shall strike them down with the sword."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 20:4 (ESV): "He shall carry them captive to Babylon, and shall strike them down with the sword."

questions.question: "And you, Pashhur, and all who dwell in your house, shall go into captivity. To Babylon you shall go, and there you shall die, and there you shall be buried, you and all your friends, to whom you have prophesied..."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 20:6 (ESV): "you and all your friends, to whom you have prophesied falsely."

questions.question: Jeremiah complained to the Lord: "O Lord, you have... me, and I was...; you are stronger than I, and you have prevailed."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 20:7 (ESV): "O Lord, you have deceived me, and I was deceived;" (Note: Some translations use 'persuaded' or 'enticed').

questions.question: "I have become a laughingstock all the day; everyone... me."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 20:7 (ESV): "I have become a laughingstock all the day; everyone mocks me."

questions.question: "For whenever I speak, I cry out, I shout, '... and destruction!' For the word of the Lord has become for me a reproach and derision all day long."
What happens if Jeremiah says, "I will not mention him, or speak any more in his name"?
options: There is in his heart as it were a burning fire shut up in his bones, and he is weary with holding it in, and he cannot.
He is struck dumb and cannot speak.
An angel of the Lord forces him to speak.
The Lord strikes him with a plague.
questions.correctAnswer: There is in his heart as it were a burning fire shut up in his bones, and he is weary with holding it in, and he cannot.
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 20:9 (ESV): "there is in my heart as it were a burning fire shut up in my bones, and I am weary with holding it in, and I cannot."

questions.question: Jeremiah says, "For I hear many whispering. Terror is on every side! '... him! Let us... him!' say all my familiar friends, watching for my fall."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 20:10 (ESV): "'Denounce him! Let us denounce him!' say all my familiar friends,"

questions.question: "But the Lord is with me as a dread...; therefore my persecutors will stumble; they will not overcome me."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 20:11 (ESV): "But the Lord is with me as a dread warrior;"

questions.question: "Sing to the Lord; praise the Lord! For he has delivered the life of the... from the hand of evildoers."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 20:13 (ESV): "For he has delivered the life of the needy from the hand of evildoers."

questions.question: "Cursed be the day on which I was...! The day when my mother bore me, let it not be blessed!"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 20:14 (ESV): "Cursed be the day on which I was born!"

questions.question: "Cursed be the man who brought the news to my father, 'A... is born to you,' making him very glad."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 20:15 (ESV): "Cursed be the man who brought the news to my father, 'A son is born to you,'"

key_verse_text: If I say, "I will not mention him, or speak any more in his name," there is in my heart as it were a burning fire shut up in my bones, and I am weary with holding it in, and I cannot.
